items.claim: Rafael Tobias's wins rely on him being bigger, stronger, and faster than his opponents to mug them with physicality.
items.quote: Tobias to me is somebody who, when you look at the guys that he's fought, how he beats the guys, it's just somebody who is bigger, stronger, faster than the guys that he's fighting, and just kind of mugs them with his physicality

items.claim: Lucas Fernando throws very straight punches right down the middle.
items.quote: Everything's coming right down the middle. Straight one-two, straight jab, straight cross.

items.claim: Neil Magny is a taller, longer striker with more tools and better kicks than Ramiz Brahimaj.
items.quote: Maybe. Yeah, he's a taller, he's longer, he's got more tools, he's got better kicks.

items.claim: Neil Magny has a slight frame and could not naturally make 185 pounds.
items.quote: Neil Magny does not have that. Neil Magny couldn't make 180. Excuse me, 185. If Neil Magny was making 185, it was because he was carrying two 10-lb dumbbells in his hands. That's just the kind of frame that he's got.
